steps_tex: Three angles of $70^\circ$ add up to $3 \times 70^\circ = 210^\circ$, which is more than $180^\circ$. So no triangle has all angles equal to $70^\circ$.
If two angles are $70^\circ$, the third is $180^\circ - 70^\circ - 70^\circ = 40^\circ$.
If all three angles are equal and each is $x$, then $3x = 180^\circ$, so $x = 60^\circ$.
item.answer_tex: No triangle has three angles of $70^\circ$; two angles of $70^\circ$ give a third of $40^\circ$; equal angles must each be $60^\circ$

item.question: Find ∠ACD, if ∠A = 50° and ∠B = 60°, and then try ∠A = 35° and ∠B = 45°. What do you notice?
steps_tex: First case: $50^\circ + 60^\circ + \angle ACB = 180^\circ$, so $\angle ACB = 70^\circ$.
$\angle ACB$ and $\angle ACD$ form a straight angle, so $\angle ACD = 180^\circ - 70^\circ = 110^\circ$.
Second case: $35^\circ + 45^\circ + \angle ACB = 180^\circ$, so $\angle ACB = 100^\circ$, and $\angle ACD = 180^\circ - 100^\circ = 80^\circ$.
In the first case $110^\circ = 50^\circ + 60^\circ$; in the second case $80^\circ = 35^\circ + 45^\circ$.
The exterior angle equals the sum of the two interior angles that are not next to it.
item.answer_tex: $\angle ACD = 110^\circ$, and in general an exterior angle is the sum of the two opposite interior angles

steps_tex: Draw $AC = 5\text{ cm}$. The angle at $B$ is $90^\circ$, so $\angle A + \angle C = 90^\circ$.

Choose $\angle A = 30^\circ$, then $\angle C = 60^\circ$, and the arms cross at $B$. Choose $\angle A = 45^\circ$, then $\angle C = 45^\circ$. Choose $\angle A = 70^\circ$, then $\angle C = 20^\circ$. Each choice gives a different triangle.

item.question: A spider walks from one corner of a box 6 cm long, 4 cm wide and 3 cm high to the opposite corner, over two faces. Which path is shortest?
steps: Lay two faces flat side by side. The path is a straight line across the joined faces.
Case 1: the line goes 6 cm along and 4 + 3 = 7 cm across. Draw this rectangle and measure the diagonal: about 9.2 cm.
Case 2: 4 cm along and 6 + 3 = 9 cm across. The diagonal measures about 9.8 cm.
Case 3: 3 cm along and 6 + 4 = 10 cm across. The diagonal measures about 10.4 cm.
The shortest is the first, about 9.2 cm. It is shorter than going along the edges, which is 6 + 4 + 3 = 13 cm.
item.answer: About 9.2 cm, across the 6 by 4 face and the 6 by 3 face laid flat
